title: AI Park Design Challenge – Al Safa 2 Park Redesign
description: Complete workflow for the Dubai Municipality AI Design Challenge, integrating human‑centred design, AI tools, and the required concept & preliminary design stages.

children.label: 1. Design Challenge Brief & Team Assembly
children.description: Thorough review of TOR, schedules, and evaluation matrix. Assemble a multidisciplinary team (landscape architect, urban designer, AI specialist, sustainability engineer, etc.).

children.label: TOR & Deliverables Analysis
children.description: Interpret the brief: Concept & Preliminary Design stages, required deliverables (3x A1 boards, design report, AI methodology report, 1‑minute animation, CAD files). Understand the AED 35M budget and 15,000 m² site.

children.label: Team & AI Tool Selection
children.description: Form team with defined roles. Select AI platforms for analysis (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, RunwayML, Grasshopper plugins) and simulation tools (ENVI‑met, Ladybug, AnyLogic).

children.label: 2. Redesign Justification (Why Redesign)
children.description: Identify the shortcomings of the existing park and establish strategic objectives aligned with Dubai 2040 and community needs.

children.label: Existing Park Condition Audit
children.description: On‑site inspection of ageing infrastructure, inadequate shading, poor accessibility, and lack of inclusive facilities. Use photographic documentation and condition mapping.

children.label: Stakeholder & Community Aspirations
children.description: Identify gaps in user satisfaction through interviews and social media sentiment. Define key drivers: safety, thermal comfort, intergenerational spaces, and sense of belonging.

children.label: Alignment with Dubai 2040 & Sustainability Goals
children.description: Set measurable KPIs: reduce UHI by 4°C, increase native biodiversity by 40%, improve pedestrian connectivity, and achieve 100% TSE irrigation.

children.label: 3. Data Collection (Primary & Secondary)
children.description: Gather comprehensive data on site, users, microclimate, and utilities, as required by the brief. Use mixed methods: LiDAR, surveys, sensor logging, and GIS archives.

children.label: Topography & LiDAR Survey
children.description: Method: UAV‑based LiDAR to capture existing contours, tree canopy heights, and hardscape. Output: .LAS point cloud and 3D terrain model.

children.label: Microclimate & Thermal Data
children.description: Method: Deploy HOBO sensors for 7 days (temp, RH, wind speed). Use weather station data. Output: CSV time‑series for ENVI‑met calibration.

children.label: User Demographics & Intercept Surveys
children.description: Method: On‑site face‑to‑face interviews (n=300) using Kobo Toolbox. Capture usage patterns, preferences, and accessibility challenges. Output: statistical summaries and personas.

children.label: Underground Utilities & Existing Drawings
children.description: Method: Retrieve as‑built CAD (from Appendix) and Dubai Municipality GIS. Map DEWA, sewer, and irrigation mains. Output: DXF overlay and clash analysis.

children.label: Surrounding Land Use & Connectivity
children.description: Method: Spatial analysis of neighbourhood density, transport nodes, and nearby amenities. Output: GIS maps of walkability and accessibility.

children.label: 4. Comprehensive Analysis & Synthesis
children.description: Transform data into design intelligence using AI‑augmented analysis tools. Conduct SWOT, spatial suitability, and thermal comfort studies.

children.label: GIS Multi‑Criteria Spatial Suitability
children.description: Method: Weighted overlay in ArcGIS Pro to map optimal zones for planting, play areas, and quiet zones. Use AI to automate weighting based on user preferences.

children.label: SWOT & PESTLE Analysis
children.description: Method: Structured brainstorming supported by AI sentiment analysis. Strengths (central location), Weaknesses (heat), Opportunities (new mobility), Threats (sea‑level rise). Format: 2x2 matrix and radar chart.

children.label: Thermal Comfort & Microclimate Baseline
children.description: Method: ENVI‑met simulation calibrated with sensor data. Map UTCI at peak summer hours to pinpoint hotspots. Use AI to generate heat‑mitigation scenarios.

children.label: User Persona & Journey Mapping
children.description: Method: Create personas using survey data and AI‑generated user profiles. Map current pain points and desired experiences for children, families, elderly, and People of Determination.

children.label: 5. Concept Ideation (AI‑Augmented)
children.description: Generate multiple design concepts using AI for rapid iteration. Explore spatial, programmatic, and landscape alternatives.

children.label: Morphological Matrix & AI Generation
children.description: Method: Break down park components (circulation, vegetation, water, program). Use generative AI (e.g., Midjourney, Grasshopper with machine learning) to produce 50+ massing options. Format: digital matrix and image libraries.

children.label: Three Distinct Concept Scenarios (A, B, C)
children.description: Method: Divergent sketching with AI‑assisted refinement. Scenario A: 'Oasis' (heavy water and shade); B: 'Green Spine' (linear ecology); C: 'Urban Living Room' (dense programming). Format: hand sketches and AI‑enhanced mood boards.

children.label: Physical Massing Models (Foam)
children.description: Method: 1:1000 scale foam models to test volumetric relationships and sightlines, integrated with AI‑generated 3D prints.

children.label: Draft AI Methodology Report
children.description: Document the AI tools used, workflows, and how AI influenced each concept. This will be finalised later.

children.label: 6. Scenario Testing & Performance Simulation
children.description: Quantitatively validate the top concepts through AI‑driven simulations for microclimate, pedestrian flow, cost, and sustainability.

children.label: Microclimate & Solar Optimisation
children.description: Method: Test scenarios A, B, C in Ladybug + ENVI‑met. Iterate tree placement and shading structures. Use AI to suggest optimal layouts. Output: comparative comfort maps.

children.label: Pedestrian & Accessibility Simulation
children.description: Method: Agent‑based modelling in AnyLogic. Simulate peak‑hour (Friday evening) to identify bottlenecks and ensure inclusive access. Use AI to optimise path widths.

children.label: Irrigation Demand & Water Self‑Sufficiency
children.description: Method: Calculate ET rates and rainwater capture. Validate feasibility of 100% TSE irrigation with AI‑based predictive models.

children.label: Preliminary Cost & Value Engineering
children.description: Method: Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) costing for each scenario, ensuring alignment with AED 35M budget. AI‑assisted cost optimisation.

children.label: 7. Preliminary Design Development
children.description: Elaborate the selected concept into a coordinated preliminary design, integrating all program elements and preparing for submission.

children.label: Detailed Masterplan & Spatial Organisation
children.description: Method: CAD drafting in AutoCAD / Rhino. Define zoning, hierarchy, and functional relationships. Format: .DWG and scaled PDF (1:200) with dimensions.

children.label: Landscape & Public Realm Plans
children.description: Method: Develop planting palette (native, climate‑responsive), path networks, plazas, and play areas. Include irrigation zones and biodiversity enhancements.

children.label: Key Sections & Elevations
children.description: Method: Produce at least 5 critical sections and elevations illustrating topography, shading, and built elements. Format: CAD/BIM outputs.

children.label: Material & Landscape Palette
children.description: Method: Select durable, sustainable materials (permeable paving, recycled composites, etc.) with AI‑aided life‑cycle assessment.

children.label: Universal Accessibility & Circulation Strategy
children.description: Method: Ensure compliance with Dubai accessibility standards. Include detailed ramps, tactile paving, and wayfinding. Use AI to validate inclusive design.

children.label: Smart Technologies & Monitoring Strategy
children.description: Method: Propose sensor networks for irrigation, occupancy, and environmental monitoring (non‑intrusive). Align with the brief's 'smart features' requirement.

children.label: 8. Final Submission Package
children.description: Produce all required deliverables as per Schedule 2. Ensure high‑quality storytelling and professional presentation.

children.label: Design Narrative & AI Methodology Report
children.description: Method: Write a compelling narrative covering vision, human‑centred approach, sustainability, and the AI workflow (tools, processes, value added). Format: PDF booklet (20‑30 pages).

children.label: A1 Presentation Boards (3x)
children.description: Method: Layout masterplan, analysis, diagrams, renderings, and sustainability strategies. Follow the mandatory A1 landscape format. Use AI‑assisted graphic design.

children.label: High‑Quality Visualizations (Day & Night)
children.description: Method: Produce 6 photorealistic renders (aerial, main entry, central plaza, children’s zone, water feature, night scene) using VRay or Lumion. Include AI‑generated atmospherics.

children.label: 1‑Minute Concept Animation
children.description: Method: Create a flythrough video with voice‑over or music, illustrating user journey and key design features. AI tools allowed (e.g., RunwayML, Pika). Format: MP4.

children.label: Commercial & Service Facilities Plan
children.description: Method: Locate café, kiosks, and maintenance areas ensuring they enhance but do not dominate the park. Format: A3 plan with legend.

children.label: Final Quality Check & Upload
children.description: Method: Cross‑check all deliverables against the checklist (Schedule 2). Ensure files are under the required size limits and upload via the official portal by 15 August 2026.
